blurb.en: Three-voice polyphonic digital oscillator, seven waves per voice morphing from super saw to super square. Independent pitch per voice, detune and FM. Discontinued.
blurb.fi: Kolmiääninen polyfoninen digitaalioskillaattori, seitsemän aaltoa per ääni morffaa super sawsta super squareen. Itsenäinen pitch per ääni, detune ja FM. Poistunut valikoimista.
blurb.sv: Trestämmig polyfon digital oscillator, sju vågor per röst morfar från super saw till super square. Egen pitch per röst, detune och FM. Utgången ur sortimentet.

pull.q: The Chainsaw from Acid Rain Technology is a polyphonic digital oscillator with super saws and super features.

quotes.t: The seven waves can be detuned using the detune knob and CV input; at low settings the waves are in unison, but as the value increases, the waves spread apart.
